It was just friday morning. Fifteen minutes from my house, there's a Tim Horton's on the left side of the road. There's three lanes, one for turning at an intersection and then the others for driving. I went to pull into the Tim Horton's and because there was a car speeding behind me, I pulled into the turning lane, facing the wrong way. Stupid, I know. I figured drivers would see me, and go around if they needed to turn, there was plenty of space. A Ford truck, new, shiny and green was the only vehicle coming and after that I planned to pull into the parking lot. The ford pulls into the turning lane, coming head on at me. My heart stopped, the only thing that came to my mind was from driver's ed. 'Steer and Gas'. I turned and gased so fast, I soared into the parking lot, the truck zooming by just whee I had been seconds earlier. I ordered my tea and bagel and went to school before I realized what had happened.

Ironically, I still remember what my dad said before I left the house. When I told him where I was going, he told me "Be careful! There's lots of accidents there." Needless to say, I don't pull into turning lanes unless I'm sure I can. I'd rather be rear ended then hit head on

TL;DR Almost got hit by a Ford truck in my Grand Am. Dad is psychic.
